title: CIPS vs SWIFT: The Shadow War Over Global Payments
description: How China's CIPS payment system is challenging SWIFT's global dominance — and what this hidden power struggle means for currency relationships and the future of international finance.

title: Reference Rate vs Bank Rate: Why the Number You See Is Not the Rate You Get
description: The exchange rate displayed on any screen is rarely the rate you actually receive. Understanding the gap between reference rates and customer rates is essential to navigating cross-border money.
